launch.credential_boundary: scoped OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD materialized only to the user-owned route process

schema_and_health_probe.schema: GET /doc and pin the OpenAPI 3.1 digest
schema_and_health_probe.health: GET /global/health then create, prompt, observe, and abort one disposable session
schema_and_health_probe.negative_capability_challenge: request one optional session or tool method with a harmless invalid identifier and require a typed non-success

model_selection.selection: model field on the public session message or prompt_async request

session_control.resume: GET /session/:id then continue through the message surface

event_contract.source: GET /event or /global/event server-sent event stream plus plugin pre-effect observations
event_contract.ordering: server event identity and cursor wrapped in ELIOT EventEnvelope sequence

child_agents.native_surface: session parentID, child-session listing, and agent selection are documented but not automatically admitted as ELIOT delegation

execution_routes.proof_ceiling: The public OpenAPI/SSE surface can host one bounded candidate attempt; OpenCode internal storage and plugin callbacks are not ELIOT task or recovery truth.

probe_requirements: pin executable and OpenAPI digest for the exact installed runtime
prove health, provider/model discovery, session create, prompt, SSE terminal event, fork, and abort
prove plugin mutating gates fail closed only for attached mutating tasks
prove passive plugin events use bounded serialized dispatch and cannot exhaust child processes
prove no environment outside the explicit allowlist reaches the bridge process
prove child-session closure and cancellation before parent attempt disposition
known_gaps: the HTTP/SSE adapter and User Broker launch path are not implemented in this profile change
the existing plugin still invokes the legacy bridge executable for host events
current-account provider, model, quota, and auth behavior are unprobed
OpenCode internal runtime storage remains forensic-only and cannot resume ELIOT authority
